sections.position: Director of Strategic Partnerships @ Global Knowledge
sections.bio:
The Human Side of High Performance | Where Productivity & Performance Meet

Kasia is a Corporate Healer & Strategic Partnerships Leader at the intersection of wellness, performance, and business growth. She creates content for ambitious professionals in IT, consulting, sales, and entrepreneurship, helping them improve well-being, productivity, and sustainable performance. 

Through authentic brand partnerships, Kasia connects high-trust audiences with products and services that support healthier, higher-performing lives and improved results at work.

sections.title: Why work with me
sections.body:
I create content at the intersection of high performance, wellness & personal growth that inspires people to take meaningful action 

By bridging two worlds that rarely meet, business performance and inner transformation, I help brands connect with credible storytelling while building trust, driving engagement & creating lasting brand affinity

*I partner with brands that genuinely improve people's lives. If your product or service helps people work, live, or perform better, I'll create content that feels human, memorable, and genuinely impactful. NOT like an ad!

sections.title: What I offer
sections.body: I am a video-first creator although I'm open to direction & your vision when exploring opportunities with aligned brands!

sections.title: Time from booking to post
sections.body:
I can publish within 72 hours of accepting a booking

If the product or service is intricate, I prefer to interact with it to get a feel & be able to speak from firsthand experience
